description: This file defines a test class that implements the ISiloMetadataCache interface, providing a mock or test implementation for caching SiloMetadata objects keyed by SiloAddress, used within unit tests related to placement filtering in Orleans.

classes.name: TestSiloMetadataCache
classes.description: A test implementation of the ISiloMetadataCache interface for unit testing, using an in-memory dictionary to store and retrieve SiloMetadata objects.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the SiloMetadata associated with the given SiloAddress from the internal cache; returns an empty metadata instance if not found.
